data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C AI & Software company founded by Chase Lochmiller and Cully Cavness, currently valued at $10B+ with $3B+ raised to date. The peer universe comprises 8 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir), including Figure AI, Scale AI, Skild AI, Wayve, and Physical Intelligence at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods apply to this valuation. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $10.0B last post-money valuation, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to later-stage progression, yielding $17.0B. Peer-median analysis draws from 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $8.6B, though the range spans $2.0B (low) to $39.0B (Figure AI at Series C). The wide dispersion reflects early-stage AI sector volatility, with Figure AI and Scale AI as high outliers at $39.0B and $29.0B respectively.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $7.3B (low) to $19.6B (high), with a median of $12.8B. This median sits above Crusoe's stated $10B+ current valuation, consistent with forward-looking Series C progression. Key uncertainties include path-to-revenue visibility, capital efficiency relative to peer burn profiles, and sector-wide funding environment stability. The wide peer range ($2.0B–$39.0B) underscores valuation sensitivity to perceived technology differentiation and market timing within AI infrastructure.
